_what: Panel package digests, published on a channel the update server does not control (register item 783).
_why: The .ccx carries no signature. The helper refuses to install a panel unless beatmaxing.com and this file agree on its sha256, so one compromised host is not enough.
_release_step: Add one line here for every panel version BEFORE the manifest on beatmaxing.com offers it. A version missing here cannot be installed - that is deliberate.
_never: DO NOT make the two channels reconcile automatically. A GitOps-style loop that syncs this file from beatmaxing.com (or the reverse) DESTROYS the only property that makes two channels worth having: they must agree INDEPENDENTLY, so one compromised host is not enough. Phase 5's S8 (Building Gitops Workflows) recommends exactly that reconciliation - it is CONTRAINDICATED here, not merely inapplicable. Register items 783, 939, 945.
